test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 06 Feb 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follows from the statements.

**Statements:**

All camels are fractals.

No fractal is a tube.

All pianos are camels.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some tubes are camels.

II. No piano is a tube.

options.text: Either conclusion I or II follows
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd54e59cc9abd6d7e48b146fd3a0dd252197e0780eab0630ca2c30b6e961fa8f.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some tubes are camels. → Does not follow (As, All camels are fractals and No fractal is a tube, which means no camel is tube)

II. No piano is a tube. → **Follows** (As, All pianos are camel, All camels are fractals and No fractal is a tube, which means no piano is a tube)

Hence, '**Only conclusion II follows**' is the correct answer.
